subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu's shipped `auto` and table-conversion behavior remain compatible, with native `tag:md` posts using the existing non-card configuration, or should native posts become the new default for code blocks and tables?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but changing the default carrier and making a persisted rendering setting inert is an upgrade-policy choice that source inspection cannot resolve.

options.title: Split and preserve defaults
options.body: Land inbound `content_v2` separately and retain current automatic card routing and configured table conversion for existing users.

options.title: Approve the new default
options.body: Intentionally switch code blocks and tables to native posts after adding upgrade documentation, configuration semantics, and carrier-level proof.

options.title: Pause outbound work
options.body: Keep only the inbound capability and defer outbound carrier changes until Feishu platform behavior and product expectations are settled.

recommendation.title: Split and preserve defaults
recommendation.body: Land inbound `content_v2` separately and retain current automatic card routing and configured table conversion for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current outbound render-mode contract and makes them the strongest history-backed routing candidate available.
